voice.recordingScript: "Once upon a time, far beyond the distant mountains, there was a little village among the stars. The children living there looked up at the sky every night. For them, every star was the beginning of a story. As the wind blew softly, the moonlight spread over the rooftops like a silver blanket. The children told each other their favorite tales, admiring the courage of the heroes. Now close your eyes and take a deep breath. Tonight, your story begins…"
